name: aiball-mcp
display_name: AI Ball — AI football match analysis
description: Football match outcome probabilities recorded before kick-off, and the open record of how they turned out.
long_description: Read-only access to AI Ball's public record. For each match: the model's home / draw / away probabilities as recorded before kick-off, the final score, and whether the most likely outcome happened. For any day, week or the whole record: how many matches went the model's way, next to two baselines on the same matches (always taking the pre-match favourite, and one in three). Misses are counted the same way as hits. No account or API key needed.

tools.name: list_matches
tools.description: Matches for one day: ids, teams, kick-off, status

tools.name: get_match_analysis
tools.description: Pre-kick-off outcome probabilities for one match, and the result once played

tools.name: get_open_record
tools.description: How the model's reads turned out: whole record or one week
